environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in vpc-0a3f2c (prod-directory-sync) with task role arn:aws:iam::441199223344:role/DirectorySyncTaskRole. Service is exposed via internal ALB on port 8080. LDAP server is OpenLDAP 2.4.57 at directory.internal:389. The task role has DynamoDB PutItem/GetItem on table 'UserMetadata' with no condition keys. ALB has no WAF association. Security group sg-0bf4a allows inbound 8080 from 10.0.0.0/8. No input validation middleware configured on the Gin router.
